messages:
Ben C: hi all, I'm Ben (started today). I can view the Notion onboarding pages but not edit. Where are the canonical templates stored and how do I get edit rights quickly?
Riley M: welcome Ben! :tada: Canonical templates live in the shared workspace 'Redwood Docs' > Templates > Onboarding (we have Eng, PM, Sales variants).
Ben C: I can see that path but pages are view-only. The 'Request edit' button routes to a generic queue. Is there a faster path for new hires?
Ivy (Docs): hey Ben : short answer: fill the IT access form to join the Docs Editors group, or duplicate the template to your personal workspace and submit via docs-bot if you need to propose changes immediately.
Taylor (IT): Hi Ben : add this form (Notion > Contributor): https://forms.redwood.internal/it-access. Put your manager on the form for quick approval. Once approved we add you to the SSO group and you get edit rights across team pages. Typical turnaround 15-60m.
Ben C: ok thanks. If I duplicate a template and edit, how do we make that live?
Ivy (Docs): use our contribution flow: Duplicate (with subpages) into your workspace, edit, then Share > Invite docs-bot@redwood to submit. Docs-bot opens a GitHub PR to docs-templates repo; Docs team reviews and merges. After merge the canonical page can be updated and synced back.
Docs Bot: Reminder: Onboarding checklist step "Notion write access". Reply "manager: NAME" to auto-notify Docs and IT for faster processing.
Ben C: manager: Riley M
Riley M: Approved. Ivy, please watch for Ben's contrib. Also note naming convention: prefix titles with the team in brackets like "[SWE]  First Week Checklist" to ensure search and permission consistency.
Ivy (Docs): also add a one-line summary at the top and a small metadata footer: Owner, Last updated, Related repos. If creating a new template, please include an example 1:1 schedule and repo access checklist.
Ben C: perfect. Which template shows an example first-week schedule I can copy?
Riley M: go to Templates > Onboarding > Eng > "New Hire  First Week (Engineering)". Copy that and adjust.
Ben C: filled the IT form and duplicated the template. I'll invite docs-bot when ready. Thanks for the quick help!
Taylor (IT): Got the form, adding you to Docs Editors now. Ping me if SSO doesn't work.
Ivy (Docs): Saw your duplicate. When you invite docs-bot include a short PR note about the changes. I'll review once the PR arrives.
Ben C: invited docs-bot and added a PR note. Appreciate it all :)
